## R Markdown
load("C:/Users/r468a762/Desktop/PhD/.RData")
> list.files()
> pv <- read.csv("p-values.csv")
> head(pv)

> str(pv)

> pv$q_fdr  <- p.adjust(pv$pvalue, method = "BH")          # Benjamini-Hochberg FDR
> pv$p_bonf <- p.adjust(pv$pvalue, method = "bonferroni")  # Bonferroni
> # Raw p-value histogram (shows the signal: spike near 0 above a uniform floor)
> hist(pv$pvalue, breaks = 50, main = "Distribution of raw p-values",
+      xlab = "p-value", col = "grey80")
> 
> # Ranked p-values against the BH threshold line — this IS the FDR procedure visualized
> alpha <- 0.05
> m <- nrow(pv)
> plot(sort(pv$pvalue), pch = 16, cex = 0.4,
+      xlab = "Rank", ylab = "p-value",
+      main = "BH procedure, q = 0.05")
> abline(0, alpha/m, col = "red")   # genes below the red line are FDR-significant
> sig_fdr  <- subset(pv, q_fdr  < 0.05)
> sig_bonf <- subset(pv, p_bonf < 0.05)
> nrow(sig_fdr); nrow(sig_bonf)

> write.csv(sig_fdr,  "significant_FDR.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
> write.csv(sig_bonf, "significant_Bonferroni.csv", row.names = FALSE)
> # Zoom into the region where the line and curve actually cross
> plot(sort(pv$pvalue)[1:6000], pch = 16, cex = 0.4,
+      xlab = "Rank", ylab = "p-value",
+      main = "BH procedure, q = 0.05 (first 6000 genes)")
> abline(0, alpha/m, col = "red", lwd = 2)
> abline(v = 3903, lty = 2, col = "blue")   # the crossover: last FDR-significant gene
> max(sig_fdr$pvalue)

> png("pvalue_histogram.png", width = 828, height = 399)
> hist(pv$pvalue, breaks = 50,
+      main = "Distribution of raw p-values (26,882 genes)",
+      xlab = "p-value", col = "grey80")
> abline(v = 9.94e-05, col = "red", lwd = 2)
> dev.off()


```
